name: dots-brain
description: Install and operate self-hosted MCP memory for explicitly saved notes.

interface.shortDescription: One memory for your AI tools
interface.longDescription: Save and retrieve source-aware notes through MCP on your Linux memory host. Configure supported local clients and owner-approved OAuth access. Public ingress is operated separately; capture and CORTEX modules are disabled.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up Dots Brain on my memory host and verify the available capabilities.
